features.browserEvidence: All 14 preserved RichViz visual types rendered from canonical examples in the live Edge audit; all reported ready.
Mermaid, XYFlow/React Flow, Chart.js, Recharts, ECharts, and Plotly adapters rendered live; all six were ready.
Seven native SVG chart forms rendered in the browser without adding runtime dependencies.

Live map exposed three selectable nodes and two edges; pan, pinch, zoom, node summary selection, text alternative, static/interactive toggle and stable route callback next-lesson worked. The initially focused node remained inside the viewport at all tested widths.

Automatic layout is deterministic; fit and minimap are present. Map coordinates use a physical left/top origin independent of RTL. Initial focus fits after DOM layout; resize refits until the learner changes the view. At 360, 768 and 1440 CSS px the selected node stayed visible without page overflow.

A slider changed the bound RichViz value from 12 to 63 in the live article; safe typed paths only, immutable clone, and no prototype traversal. Map labels stayed at 16px and the responsive page had no horizontal overflow.

Zoom, fit, text, and static/interactive controls worked. The environment denied the native fullscreen request (TypeError: not granted); the tested fallback expanded the map fixed to the viewport, set aria-pressed, then restored the original layout on the next activation. Native browser fullscreen itself remains unverified.
Search, group filters, 24-item pagination (373 total / 16 pages), metadata, and previews passed for diagrams, adapters, trusted glyphs, application icons, illustrations, and stickers.

Asset catalog preserves 231 GPL-3.0-or-later Captiva application icons in a separate notice boundary and 23 Apache-2.0 illustrations/stickers. Stable IDs, paths, provenance, and hashes passed catalog checks. Vendor code and source ZIP were not edited.
